events.title: The Shield-Menders
events.description: At a shield repair queue, a huge patched shield props up the town gate.

choices.text: Stand watch by the giant shield (+2 scraps)
Trade a spare shield rivet (spend 1 scrap; gain 17 gold)

events.title: Scarlet Thread Cart
events.description: The seamstress finds a wagon knotted with red-thread pennants and giant needles.

choices.text: Sew the red pennant (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Buy a red-thread bundle (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)

events.title: The Clockwork Wagon
events.description: A clockwork trader's wagon ticks under a load of crooked buttons and gears.

choices.text: Repair the wagon ratchet (spend 2 scraps; gain 28 gold)

events.title: Moth Vigil
events.description: A warm patchwork lantern gathers moths beside a candlelit cloth shrine.

choices.text: Guide the moths by lantern light (+2 scraps)
Buy lantern wax (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)

events.title: The Needle Fair
events.description: A caped duelist holds a friendly fencing fair with a long thin needle rapier.

choices.text: Win the friendly fencing purse (+20 gold)
Buy two red ribbon bundles (spend 10 gold; gain 2 scraps)
